caption: Kar. 73. Stela
reading: wosi : soreyi? : q?o a(2)deliyeqowi : api(3)lye tedḫelowi : te(4)lepol : terikelowi : (5)pqrleb : yetmdelo : (6)pesetoleb : yet(7)mdelowi : mlomrse : n(8)lotetelowi : ato(9)mẖe : psoẖekete : a(10)tmẖe psḫrkete : (11)ḫmlol : pẖolkete : m(12)lolo :
notes: Rows hold two or three stone lines each; read right block then left block, top to bottom, following Griffith's line numbers 1-12. Values fixed from words that recur: tedḫe-lowi, terike-lowi, yetmde-lo(wi), mlomrse, ato mẖe / at mẖe, psḫr-ke-lo. The slash plus barred hook (Griffith's te form) is read te in tedḫe/terike/te-...; at the end of the offering formulas the same form is read lo (o + l) as the formula ending; this te/lo split is the main uncertainty. Open S is read e or l by context (S = l in mlomrse and -lowi). Line 1 end '3//' (q?o) could be ẖy or m + y; the sign under (2) is a crossed sign with a loop (ñ or d). Line 3 '4' after k/p has an extra stroke (i? or l). 'pqr' sign before e: small flat-topped hook, l?. Final sign of lines 5 and 6 groups is an inverted-v with tail, d per Griffith's table (could be n). (6) group: p e se ḫ e e d? with se from 'v//'. Line 8 'te te': two barred hooks each with slash (could be lo lo). First offering formula (line 9): sign before lo is hatched/blackened, read e?; '3 small-S' pair unclear. S+long-tailed sign read as a in ato/at but as k+e in the formula endings (-kelo).
check_notes: All 24 entries placed. Key facts the type settled for this copy: the 4-plus-hook ligature is li (adeliyeqowi, apilye); the slash with barred hook is te, also at the formula ends (-kete), not lo; the open-loop c-shape before l in pesetoleb is to, not ḫ; the inverted-v with tail is b (pqrleb, pesetoleb), not d; the 3 after p in formulas A and C is ẖ. Line-1 '3//' (q?o) before the name is covered by no entry and stays. Copy has no divider between at mẖe and psḫrkete (type has one). Final word: copy shows m l o l o only; Index B lists Kar. 73 under final mlolowi (wi not in the copy, not added).

notes: Order follows Griffith's line numbers 1-18 (rows hold several lines; right block first). The l-ligature (4 + hook) is read l from terike-lowi in line 11; in line 4 'tedḫ' it stands where e is expected (tedḫe?). The '8'-shaped closed sign read e (tedḫ-8 in line 4). Lines 8-10 repeat te-r-i-k-e-l : three times. Line 4 'te?epn': barred hook + slash, 8, p, n with long tail; reading uncertain. Line 6 group: w o, a hooked 2 (m?) at the end of a long tail, S+long tail read a (could be e+k). Line 12: 'pqr' with r drawn as ɷ. Line 12 second group: y, sic sign, 7-shaped m?, d, e, l, o, w, i (yetmdelowi with t and e confused). Line 13-16: ato mẖe / at mẖe formulas; first formula p q o ẖ(hatched) lo, second psḫr-ke-lo. Line 17: ḫ m l o l then p q l + S-with-long-tail sign read k e (not a), then lo. Line 18: m l o m r(sic) d? l w i, perhaps mlomrse-lowi written oddly.
check_notes: 32 of 33 entries placed; 'mtelowi (following se)' not found (no se before mtelowi in this copy). The type settled: 4-plus-hook ligature = li (terikeli, tedḫli, mli, sotnkeli, tnbelileqowi); the 8-shaped sign = w in tewen, e in tnbelileqowi and sotnkeli; the inverted-v with tail = b in tnbelileqowi; ʂ-plus-long-tailed-2 = n in womnitẖ; closed 3 with lead-in stroke = s in psoẖte and sotnkeli. A third te-r-i-k-e-li group (line 10-11, with an extra sign before r and o w i after) is in the copy though the index gives terikeli only twice. Line 12 pqrl: copy has one more sign after l (kept as e?). yetmdelowi: copy has one sic sign where the type has e t (kept, not added). Final mlo mrtowi: copy shows d-like sign (sic) for t and a Ꮭ-shaped sign for o; kept, no divider between mlo and mrtowi in the copy.
